tools_used: pypdf (local text extraction of fetched PDFs)
helpful: Provisioned petition and BIO text: the BIO alone reframed the cell (Hemani decided against the government; identical SG petitions already denied).
supremecourt.gov docket pages via WebFetch gave complete comparator histories where CourtListener had none.
The sal-v4 band table made the anchor and the reason to depart from it explicit.
gaps: CourtListener MCP hit the 25/min rate limit on most of the first batch of calls and carried no docket entries for recent SCOTUS dockets; a sidecar-side retry/backoff or a higher limit would help.
WebFetch cannot read PDFs; I had to extract fetched PDFs locally. A PDF-aware fetch would save a step.
A corpus filter by petitioner class (federal/state/private) or by counsel of record would let `fedcourts query` surface SG-petition comparators directly.
notes: Roughly 20 retrieval calls including rate-limited failures, within the advisory budget.
